name: Thalobek
source:
Not always the sharpest thinker, but her heart is in the right place. Thalobek tends to leap before she looks, and sadly she also does not always have the best ideas. But her enthusiasm tend to lead to her coming out on top either way, and what she lacks in brains, she makes up for with courage and a grin full of sharp teeth.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4014730/Harem_of_Ankhutep/]Steam[/url]]
